title: Oscar®-Qualifying HollyShorts Film Festival 2023
deck: The first year as art director, and dozens of original artworks.
lede: In 2023, Dalton Corr became the festival's art director. The edition's painted palms, sea and red carpet went onto Hollywood billboards and badges, and onto a list of the world's best festival posters.
challenge: The 19th HollyShorts Film Festival took place at the TCL Chinese Theatres in Hollywood in August 2023, the first edition with Dalton Corr as art director. The festival needed a new look, developed with its executive team, and a design team kept in step so that every physical and digital piece matched.
work: The look was developed with the festival's executive team, and it ran to dozens of original artworks for posters, decorations, badges, merchandise, billboards, online media and event invitations, with a design team managed to keep all of it consistent.

The poster art is a painted scene of palms, sea and a crowd on the red carpet. It ran on billboards above the Walk of Fame and at Hollywood intersections, became a painted backdrop for photographs in the lobby, and was printed on the festival tee. Each pass type had its own badge: All Access, Filmmaker, Press, Screenwriter, Staff, Sponsor and Day Pass.
system: One per pass type, several in variants.
Graphics for the festival's online media.
credits: Dalton Corr: art direction, lead design, original artwork, design team management
press: Radio du Cinéma interviewed Dalton Corr.
The festival was covered by Deadline and Variety.
